title: The astounding athletic power of quadcopters | Raffaello D'Andrea
speaker: Raffaello D'Andrea

sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast So what does it mean for a machine to be athletic?
sentences.zh: 机器的运动性能指的是什么？

sentences.en: We will demonstrate the concept of machine athleticism and the research to achieve it with the help of these flying machines called quadrocopters, or quads, for short.
sentences.zh: 我们将向你展示机器运动性能的概念及对此所做的相关研究工作。我们将借助这些被称为四轴飞行器或简称“四轴”的飞行机器人来做演示。

sentences.en: Quads have been around for a long time. They're so popular these days because they're mechanically simple.
sentences.zh: 四轴飞行器存在有很长一段时间了。它们之所以如此受欢迎，是因为它们机械构造简单。

sentences.en: By controlling the speeds of these four propellers, these machines can roll, pitch, yaw, and accelerate along their common orientation.
sentences.zh: 只要通过控制四个螺旋桨的速度，飞行器便可完成横滚、俯仰、偏摆等动作并能沿着同一个方向加速。

sentences.en: On board are also a battery, a computer, various sensors and wireless radios.
sentences.zh: 飞行器上还装有电池、电脑及各种感应器和无线收发器。

sentences.en: Quads are extremely agile, but this agility comes at a cost.
sentences.zh: 四轴飞行器运行极其灵活，但也正因其灵活性，

sentences.en: They are inherently unstable, and they need some form of automatic feedback control in order to be able to fly.
sentences.zh: 它运行却相对不稳定，需要某种形式的自动反馈装置控制才能顺利飞行。

sentences.en: So, how did it just do that? Cameras on the ceiling and a laptop serve as an indoor global positioning system.
sentences.zh: 那么，它是如何完成刚才的动作的呢？天花板上的摄像机与笔记本电脑配合成为室内的定位系统，

sentences.en: It's used to locate objects in the space that have these reflective markers on them.
sentences.zh: 用来定位在空间中带有反光感应的飞行器。

sentences.en: This data is then sent to another laptop that is running estimation and control algorithms, which in turn sends commands to the quad, which is also running estimation and control algorithms.
sentences.zh: 收集到的数据被发送到正在进行运行估算的另一台电脑上，电脑将指令反馈给也在运行估算的四轴飞行器上。

sentences.en: The bulk of our research is algorithms. It's the magic that brings these machines to life.
sentences.zh: 我们的大部分时间是花在研究运算法则上正是这些运算法赋予了机器新生命。

sentences.en: So how does one design the algorithms that create a machine athlete?
sentences.zh: 那么 如何设计运算法则来让机械具有运动员一般的灵活性呢？

sentences.en: We use something broadly called model-based design.
sentences.zh: 我们采用称为 “基于模型设计” 的方法

sentences.en: We first capture the physics with a mathematical model of how the machines behave.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们以数学模式来形容机器运作的物理特征

sentences.en: We then use a branch of mathematics called control theory to analyze these models and also to synthesize algorithms for controlling them.
sentences.zh: 然后使用数学理论的分支 — 控制理论来分析这些数学模式，与集合各种算法来控制他们。

sentences.en: For example, that's how we can make the quad hover.
sentences.zh: 举例说明，这就是我们如何能让飞行器在空中悬浮：

sentences.en: We first captured the dynamics with a set of differential equations.
sentences.zh: 我们先以微分方程式来描述悬浮的物理现象。

sentences.en: We then manipulate these equations with the help of control theory to create algorithms that stabilize the quad.
sentences.zh: 然后使用控制理论来重整这些方程式，进而得出稳定飞行器的运算法。

sentences.en: Let me demonstrate the strength of this approach.
sentences.zh: 现在我来演示这种计算方法的优势。

sentences.en: Suppose that we want this quad to not only hover but to also balance this pole.
sentences.zh: 假如，我们想让飞行器不仅在空中悬浮，而且还能平衡这支杆子

sentences.en: With a little bit of practice, it's pretty straightforward for a human being to do this, although we do have the advantage of having two feet on the ground and the use of our very versatile hands.
sentences.zh: 只要稍加练习，对人来说，轻易就能让杆子平衡我们的优势是，我们以双脚支撑平稳地站立，及我们灵活的双手。

sentences.en: It becomes a little bit more difficult when I only have one foot on the ground and when I don't use my hands.
sentences.zh: 这样就会比较困难，当我只用一只脚站立，也不用手来掌握平衡。

sentences.en: Notice how this pole has a reflective marker on top, which means that it can be located in the space.
sentences.zh: 注意，这支杆子顶上有个感应器，

sentences.en: (Audience) Oh! (Applause) (Applause ends) You can notice that this quad is making fine adjustments to keep the pole balanced.
sentences.zh: 意味着杆子能够被电脑定位。（掌声）你可以注意到四轴飞行器在进行微调，来保持杆子平衡。

sentences.en: How did we design the algorithms to do this?
sentences.zh: 我们如何设计运算法来完成这个任务呢？

sentences.en: We added the mathematical model of the pole to that of the quad.
sentences.zh: 我们把杆子的数学模式加入到四轴飞行器的数学模式上。

sentences.en: Once we have a model of the combined quad-pole system, we can use control theory to create algorithms for controlling it.
sentences.zh: 一旦得出四轴飞行器与杆综合系统的模式，我们就可采用控制理论设计运算法来控制它们。

sentences.en: Here, you see that it's stable, and even if I give it little nudges, it goes back -- to the nice, balanced position.
sentences.zh: 你看到它已经稳定了，就算我稍微触动它一下，它也会回到平衡位置。

sentences.en: We can also augment the model to include where we want the quad to be in space.
sentences.zh: 我们还可在该模式中加入操控决定飞行器在空中的位置。

sentences.en: Using this pointer, made out of reflective markers, I can point to where I want the quad to be in space a fixed distance away from me.
sentences.zh: 使用有感应器的指示器，我可以决定飞行器，在离我一定的距离内

sentences.en: (Laughter) The key to these acrobatic maneuvers is algorithms, designed with the help of mathematical models
sentences.zh: 在空中停留的位置能够让飞行器做到这些动作的关键是借助于数学模式

sentences.en: and control theory. Let's tell the quad to come back here and let the pole drop, and I will next demonstrate the importance of understanding physical models and the workings of the physical world.
sentences.zh: 和控制理论设计的运算法。我们让这个四轴飞行器回到这里，把杆子取下来。我接下来将演示理解物理模型和物理世界运作的重要性。

sentences.en: Notice how the quad lost altitude when I put this glass of water on it.
sentences.zh: 注意在我把这杯水放上去时，这个四轴飞行器怎样降低高度。

sentences.en: Unlike the balancing pole, I did not include the mathematical model of the glass in the system.
sentences.zh: 不像平衡杆子，这个系统里我不包括玻璃杯的数学模型。

sentences.en: In fact, the system doesn't even know that the glass is there.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这系统甚至不知道有杯水在那儿。

sentences.en: Like before, I could use the pointer to tell the quad where I want it to be in space.
sentences.zh: 像刚才那样，我可以用指示器指令四轴飞行器停在任何一个我指示它去的位置。

sentences.en: (Applause) (Applause ends) Okay, you should be asking yourself, why doesn't the water fall out of the glass?
sentences.zh: （掌声）好， 也许你们会问为什么水不会从玻璃杯里洒出来？

sentences.en: Two facts. The first is that gravity acts on all objects in the same way.
sentences.zh: 有两个事实：第一个是引力以同样的方式作用在所有物体上。

sentences.en: The second is that the propellers are all pointing in the same direction of the glass, pointing up.
sentences.zh: 第二个是螺旋桨都指向玻璃杯的同一个方向，朝上。

sentences.en: You put these two things together, the net result is that all side forces on the glass are small and are mainly dominated by aerodynamic effects, which at these speeds are negligible.
sentences.zh: 把这两个事实和在一起，最终结果是玻璃杯上的所有侧力小，又主要受空气动力学效应控制，因此这些速度是微不足道的。

sentences.en: And that's why you don't need to model the glass.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么不需要给玻璃杯建立模型。

sentences.en: It naturally doesn't spill, no matter what the quad does.
sentences.zh: 不需要对玻璃杯进行建模， 无论四轴飞行器做什么，它自然都不会洒出来。

sentences.en: (Audience) Oh! (Applause) (Applause ends) The lesson here
sentences.zh: 不管四轴飞行器怎样飞行，玻璃杯里的水自然不洒。（掌声）

sentences.en: is that some high-performance tasks are easier than others, and that understanding the physics of the problem tells you which ones are easy and which ones are hard.
sentences.zh: 这里的教训是一些高性能作业比其它作业更容易。而理解这个问题背后的物理学，你就会知道哪些容易，哪些困难

sentences.en: In this instance, carrying a glass of water is easy.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，放一杯水很容易

sentences.en: Balancing a pole is hard. We've all heard stories of athletes performing feats while physically injured.
sentences.zh: 平衡一个杆子很难我们都听过这样的故事，运动员身体受伤时表现出的壮举。

sentences.en: Can a machine also perform with extreme physical damage?
sentences.zh: 四轴飞行器外形极端受损时，是否也能飞？

sentences.en: Conventional wisdom says that you need at least four fixed motor propeller pairs in order to fly, because there are four degrees of freedom to control: roll, pitch, yaw and acceleration.
sentences.zh: 传统观念认为至少需要四对固定电机螺旋桨来飞，因为要控制四个自由度：滚转、俯仰、偏摆 和加速。

sentences.en: Hexacopters and octocopters, with six and eight propellers, can provide redundancy, but quadrocopters are much more popular because they have the minimum number of fixed motor propeller pairs: four.
sentences.zh: 六轴飞行器和八轴飞行器各带有带六个和八个螺旋桨可以提供冗余。但四轴飞行器更普遍，因为它们的固定电动螺旋桨数量最少：四个。

sentences.en: Or do they? (Audience) Oh! (Laughter) If we analyze the mathematical model of this machine
sentences.zh: 是吗？如果我们分析一下只带两个工作螺旋桨的飞行器的数学模型，

sentences.en: with only two working propellers, we discover that there's an unconventional way to fly it.
sentences.zh: 会发现有一个非常规的飞行方式。

sentences.en: We relinquish control of yaw, but roll, pitch and acceleration can still be controlled with algorithms that exploit this new configuration.
sentences.zh: 我们不控制偏摆，但利用这个新配置的算法滚动、俯仰和加速仍然可以得到控制。

sentences.en: Mathematical models tell us exactly when and why this is possible.
sentences.zh: 数学模型确切地告诉我们什么时候和为什么这是可能的。

sentences.en: In this instance, this knowledge allows us to design novel machine architectures or to design clever algorithms that gracefully handle damage, just like human athletes do, instead of building machines with redundancy.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这方面的知识使我们能够设计新颖的机器架构或设计巧妙的算法，妥善处理损害，就像人类运动员一样，而不是建造具有冗余的机器。

sentences.en: We can't help but hold our breath when we watch a diver somersaulting into the water, or when a vaulter is twisting in the air, the ground fast approaching.
sentences.zh: 我们禁不住屏住呼吸观看跳水运动员翻腾入水，或撑杆跳高运动员快速下落时，在空中扭转身体。

sentences.en: Will the diver be able to pull off a rip entry?
sentences.zh: 跳水运动员能压水花入水吗？

sentences.en: Will the vaulter stick the landing? Suppose we want this quad here to perform a triple flip and finish off at the exact same spot that it started.
sentences.zh: 撑杆跳高运动员会平稳落地吗？假设我们让这个四轴飞行器在同一地点开始并完成翻转三圈。

sentences.en: This maneuver is going to happen so quickly that we can't use position feedback to correct the motion during execution.
sentences.zh: 这个动作会发生得很快以至我们不能使用位置反馈信号 来纠正执行过程中的运动

sentences.en: There simply isn't enough time. Instead, what the quad can do is perform the maneuver blindly, observe how it finishes the maneuver, and then use that information to modify its behavior so that the next flip is better.
sentences.zh: 只是没有足够的时间。相反四轴所能做的就是盲目执行操作，观察它完成操作的方式，然后利用这信息修改它的行为，以便下一个翻转做得好些。

sentences.en: Similar to the diver and the vaulter, it is only through repeated practice that the maneuver can be learned and executed to the highest standard.
sentences.zh: 类似于跳水运动员和撑杆跳高运动员，只有通过反复练习才能学会这个动作

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) Striking a moving ball is a necessary skill in many sports.
sentences.zh: 并最高水平地来完成它。（掌声）击打运动中的球是许多体育项目中的一个必要技能

sentences.en: How do we make a machine do what an athlete does seemingly without effort?
sentences.zh: 我们如何让一台机器做

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) (Applause ends)
sentences.zh: 对一个运动员来说看似毫不费力的事呢？（掌声）

sentences.en: This quad has a racket strapped onto its head with a sweet spot roughly the size of an apple, so not too large.
sentences.zh: 这个四轴飞行器顶上绑有一个球拍差不多苹果大小的最佳击球位置，不能太大。

sentences.en: The following calculations are made every 20 milliseconds, or 50 times per second.
sentences.zh: 每二十毫秒进行下面的计算，或每秒50次。

sentences.en: We first figure out where the ball is going.
sentences.zh: 我们首先搞清球的去向。

sentences.en: We then next calculate how the quad should hit the ball so that it flies to where it was thrown from.
sentences.zh: 然后计算四轴飞行器应该怎样击球使它飞回被抛出的位置。

sentences.en: Third, a trajectory is planned that carries the quad from its current state to the impact point with the ball.
sentences.zh: 第三，计划一个携带四轴飞器的轨道从目前的状态到球的落点。

sentences.en: Fourth, we only execute 20 milliseconds' worth of that strategy.
sentences.zh: 第四，我们只执行值20毫秒的战略。

sentences.en: Twenty milliseconds later, the whole process is repeated until the quad strikes the ball.
sentences.zh: 二十毫秒以后，重复整个过程，

sentences.en: (Applause) Machines can not only perform dynamic maneuvers on their own, they can do it collectively.
sentences.zh: 直到四轴飞行器击到球。（掌声）机器不仅可以自己执行动态操作，还可以一起来进行。

sentences.en: These three quads are cooperatively carrying a sky net.
sentences.zh: 这三个四轴飞行器在空中共同支起一张网。

sentences.en: (Applause) (Applause ends) They perform an extremely dynamic and collective maneuver to launch the ball back to me.
sentences.zh: （掌声）它们执行一个非常动态的集体行动将球回传给我。

sentences.en: Notice that, at full extension, these quads are vertical.
sentences.zh: 注意网完全伸展时，这些四轴飞行器是垂直的。

sentences.en: (Applause) In fact, when fully extended, this is roughly five times greater than what a bungee jumper feels at the end of their launch.
sentences.zh: （掌声）事实上， 完全伸展时，这大约是五倍于蹦极者跳到最低点的力量。

sentences.en: The algorithms to do this are very similar to what the single quad used to hit the ball back to me.
sentences.zh: 计算这个的算法非常类似于用单个四轴飞行器击球回传给我。

sentences.en: Mathematical models are used to continuously re-plan a cooperative strategy 50 times per second.
sentences.zh: 使用数学模型不断重新规划一个每秒50次的合作策略。

sentences.en: Everything we have seen so far has been about the machines and their capabilities.
sentences.zh: 目前我们所看到的一切是机器和自己的能力。

sentences.en: What happens when we couple this machine athleticism with that of a human being?
sentences.zh: 当我们把机器的运动天赋和人的运动天赋连接起来会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: What I have in front of me is a commercial gesture sensor mainly used in gaming.
sentences.zh: 我面前的是一个商业用的姿势传感器，主要用于游戏。

sentences.en: It can recognize what my various body parts are doing in real time.
sentences.zh: 它可以识别我身体的不同部位实时地在做什么。

sentences.en: Similar to the pointer that I used earlier, we can use this as inputs to the system.
sentences.zh: 类似于我前面用的指示器，我们可以用这个作为系统的输入。

sentences.en: We now have a natural way of interacting with the raw athleticism of these quads with my gestures.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有一种自然的方式，让这些四轴的原始的运动天赋和我的手势交互。

sentences.en: (Applause) Interaction doesn't have to be virtual.
sentences.zh: （掌声）交互不一定是虚拟的，它可以是物质的。

sentences.en: It can be physical. Take this quad, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如这个四轴飞行器，

sentences.en: It's trying to stay at a fixed point in space.
sentences.zh: 它正设法呆在空间里的一个固定点上。

sentences.en: If I try to move it out of the way, it fights me, and moves back to where it wants to be.
sentences.zh: 如果我试图让它离开，它就抵抗我，回到它想呆的地方。

sentences.en: We can change this behavior, however. We can use mathematical models to estimate the force that I'm applying to the quad.
sentences.zh: 然而我们可以改变这种行为。我们能利用数学模型估计我正施加在四轴飞行器上的力。

sentences.en: Once we know this force, we can also change the laws of physics, as far as the quad is concerned, of course.
sentences.zh: 一旦知道了这个力，我们也可以改变物理定律，当然就四轴飞行器而言。这里四轴飞行器表现得好像它

sentences.en: Here, the quad is behaving as if it were in a viscous fluid.
sentences.zh: 在粘性流体中。

sentences.en: We now have an intimate way of interacting with a machine.
sentences.zh: 我们现在用一种亲密的方式来和机器进行交互。

sentences.en: I will use this new capability to position this camera-carrying quad to the appropriate location for filming the remainder of this demonstration.
sentences.zh: 我将用这个新的能力来把这个带有摄相机的四轴飞行器定位在合适的位置拍下剩下的演示。

sentences.en: So we can physically interact with these quads and we can change the laws of physics.
sentences.zh: 这样我们可以实际与这些四轴交互并能改变物理定律。

sentences.en: Let's have a little bit of fun with this.
sentences.zh: 让我们从中得到一点小小的乐趣。

sentences.en: For what you will see next, these quads will initially behave as if they were on Pluto.
sentences.zh: 你们接下来要看到的，这些四轴飞行器会最初表现为好像它们在冥王星上。

sentences.en: As time goes on, gravity will be increased until we're all back on planet Earth, but I assure you we won't get there.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的变化，引力会增加直到我们都回到地球上。但是我向你们保证我们不会的。

sentences.en: Okay, here goes. (Laughter)
sentences.zh: 好，开始 。

sentences.en: (Applause) Whew! You're all thinking now, these guys are having way too much fun,
sentences.zh: （笑声）（笑声）（掌声）呼！你们现在都在想，这些家伙太有意思了，

sentences.en: and you're probably also asking yourself, why exactly are they building machine athletes?
sentences.zh: 你们大概也在问自己，他们到底为什么建造机器运动员？

sentences.en: Some conjecture that the role of play in the animal kingdom is to hone skills and develop capabilities.
sentences.zh: 一些人猜想，在动物王国中发挥的作用是磨练技能和发展能力。

sentences.en: Others think that it has more of a social role, that it's used to bind the group.
sentences.zh: 其他的人则认为它有更多的社会作用，可以用来组织团队。

sentences.en: Similarly, we use the analogy of sports and athleticism to create new algorithms for machines to push them to their limits.
sentences.zh: 同样，我们使用体育和运动的类比创建了机器的新算法使它们达到自己的极限。

sentences.en: What impact will the speed of machines have on our way of life?
sentences.zh: 机器的速度对我们的生活方式会有什么影响呢？

sentences.en: Like all our past creations and innovations, they may be used to improve the human condition or they may be misused and abused.
sentences.zh: 像所有我们过去的创造和创新一样，它们要么可以用来改善人类生存条件要么可能被误用和滥用。

sentences.en: This is not a technical choice we are faced with; it's a social one.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们正面临的技术选择，而是一个社会选择。

sentences.en: Let's make the right choice, the choice that brings out the best in the future of machines, just like athleticism in sports can bring out the best in us.
sentences.zh: 让我们做出正确的诀择，这个选择带来未来机器最好的东西，就像体育中的运动能给我们带来最好的东西一样。

sentences.en: Let me introduce you to the wizards behind the green curtain.
sentences.zh: 让我来给你们介绍一下这个绿幕背后的奇才们。

sentences.en: They're the current members of the Flying Machine Arena research team.
sentences.zh: 他们是飞行器竞技场研究队的现任成员。

sentences.en: (Applause) Federico Augugliaro, Dario Brescianini, Markus Hehn, Sergei Lupashin, Mark Muller and Robin Ritz.
sentences.zh: （掌声）Federico Augugliaro, Dario Brescianini , Markus Hehn,Sergei Lupashin, Mark Muller 和 Robin Ritz。

sentences.en: Look out for them. They're destined for great things.
sentences.zh: 留心这些人，他们注定要成就大事。

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
